title: Casa Del Mar - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Casa Del Mar”, a charming and inviting coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Designed for relaxed 30A living, this beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 4-bath home comfortably sleeps 11 guests and offers the perfect balance of comfort
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Casa Del Mar”, a charming and inviting coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Designed for relaxed 30A living, this beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 4-bath home comfortably sleeps 11 guests and offers the perfect balance of comfort, convenience and coastal style. Spend your days lounging at the iconic 12,000 sq ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool, cruising to the beach on the seasonal tram or exploring nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach with the 6 included bikes. With multiple living spaces, private balconies and thoughtful amenities throughout, “Casa Del Mar” is the ideal setting for making lasting beach memories. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Seacrest Beach location just minutes from the beach, dining and shoppingSleeps 11 with 4 bedrooms and 4 full bathroomsAccess to the iconic 12,000 sq ft Seacrest Lagoon PoolSeasonal tram service to the beach and pool for easy, stress-free days6 bikes included for exploring 30A, Rosemary Beach and Alys BeachMultiple balconies and outdoor spaces for relaxing in the coastal breezeThird-floor bonus living area with wet bar and entertainment spaceChef-style kitchen with open-concept living and dining*** LIVING AREAS ***The main living space is warm, welcoming and designed for connection. Located on the 1st floor, it offers a comfortable place to gather after beach days or unwind in the evenings. Upstairs, a third-floor sitting area provides an additional space for relaxing, movie nights or entertaining, complete with a convenient wet bar for snacks and drinks.Cozy main living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVOpen-concept layout connecting living, kitchen and dining spacesThird-floor sitting area with comfortable seating and flat-screen TVBonus living space with wet bar including mini fridge, ice maker and popcorn machineIdeal layout for groups to gather while still having space to spread out*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The chef’s kitchen is thoughtfully designed for both functionality and style, making it easy to prepare meals while staying connected with your group. Whether you're enjoying a quick breakfast or a relaxed dinner at home, this space brings everyone together.Stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceBar seating for 4 perfect for casual meals or conversationDining area with seating for 4Easy access to outdoor dining and grilling area*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Enjoy the laid-back coastal lifestyle with inviting outdoor spaces designed for both quiet moments and relaxed gatherings. Grill dinner, dine outdoors or unwind on one of the balconies while taking in the fresh 30A air.Back porch with al fresco dining for 3 and gas grillPrivate balconies off the 2nd and 3rd floors with ample seatingPerfect spaces for morning coffee, sunset drinks and outdoor dining*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With a thoughtful layout across three levels, “Casa Del Mar” offers comfort and privacy for every guest, making it ideal for families and groups traveling together.1st FloorFull Guest Suite: Two full beds and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and walk-in shower2nd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and soaking tub3rd FloorBunk Room: Triple-stack twin bunk bedGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, “Casa Del Mar” places you steps from some of 30A’s most beloved destinations while offering access to resort-style community amenities.12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool: Expansive resort-style pool with waterfalls, lounging areas and family-friendly designSeasonal Tram Service: Easy transportation to the beach and poolCommunity Beach Access: Convenient access for stress-free beach daysPeddler’s Pavilion: Walk or bike to dining, shopping, live music and local favoritesRosemary Beach: A short bike ride to charming streets, boutique shopping and coastal diningAlys Beach: Nearby upscale destination known for its stunning white architecture and serene atmosphereEasy access to scenic 30A bike paths and nearby state parks*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
